2608.12123.title: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
2608.12123.paper_summary: LLM-agent services repeatedly execute small deterministic transitions between model and tool calls: route an outcome, update state, and emit the next effect. We ask when this control path exposes enough concurrent work for GPU execution, and what changes when a GPU-computed route decision remains on device. We formalize the ready-cohort boundary using fixed-partition share F, exact offline share P*, local upper bound U, and online achieved share A. Under zero service time, unlimited capacity, and equal relative launch deadlines, a specialized dynamic program computes P* exactly. In a stationary Poisson replay of one pinned 851-session public trace panel, the primary condition at 100,000 target active sessions, K=256, and a 50 ms launch deadline gives F=30.19%, P*=43.00%, and U=45.85%. Exact packing recovers 81.83% of the opportunity lost at fixed window boundaries. The outcome-derived route key is a conditioning proxy, not proof of executable identity. A separate mechanism study keeps a GPU-computed binary decision on device instead of returning four bytes to the host and redispatching. Across four named GPU placements, the device-resident path is faster in all 36 configurations; within-placement row-median ratios range from 1.19x to 2.39x. Across both admissible mechanisms, all 14,557,440 tested batched invocations match a separately implemented host oracle. A fixed nested device graph that removes no host decision is slower in all 60 configurations across five placements. Together, the studies establish two measurable gates for GPU agent control: deadline-feasible cohort supply and observation placement. A joined finite online runtime is required to measure A, CPU displacement, and service-level benefit.
2608.12123.paper_summary_zh: LLM-agent 服務重複執行模型與工具呼叫之間的小型確定性轉換：路由結果、更新狀態並產生下一個效果。 我們詢問何時此控制路徑會暴露出足夠的並行工作以進行 GPU 執行，以及當 GPU 計算的路由決策保留在設備上時會發生什麼變化。 我們使用固定分區分享 F、精確離線分享 P*、局部上界 U 和在線實現分享 A 來形式化準備群體邊界。 在零服務時間、無限制容量和相等相對啟動截止日期的情況下，專門的動態程序可以精確計算 P*。 在一個固定的 851 會話公共追蹤面板的靜態泊松重播中，主要條件在 100,000 個目標活躍會話、K=256 和 50 毫秒啟動截止日期下給出 F=30.19%、P*=43.00% 和 U=45.85%。 精確打包恢復了在固定窗口邊界上損失的 81.83% 機會。 基於結果的路由鍵是一種條件代理，而不是可執行身份的證明。 另一個機制研究將 GPU 計算的二元決策保留在設備上，而不是將四個字節返回主機並重新調度。 在四個命名的 GPU 放置中，設備常駐路徑在所有 36 種配置中都更快；同一放置的行中位數比率範圍從 1.19x 到 2.39x。 在兩種可接受的機制下，所有 14,557,440 次測試的批量調用均與單獨實現的主機神諭匹配。 一個不移除任何主機決策的固定嵌套設備圖在五個放置中的所有 60 種配置中都較慢。 總體而言，這些研究確立了 GPU 代理控制的兩個可測量閘：截止日期可行的群體供應和觀察放置。 需要一個聯合有限的在線運行時間來測量 A、CPU 位移和服務水平利益。
2608.12123.author: Josef Liyanjun Chen et.al.
